name: re-theory-chords
about: Regression re-run: Theory: a progression written and explained.

steps.say: write a sad chord progression in D minor on track 7 and explain why it sounds sad
make the last chord more tense so it pulls back to the start

name: re-long-build
about: Regression re-run: A song built over six turns, then a question about all of it.

steps.say: let's build a song together. start with a chill beat at 85
add a warm bassline
now some jazzy chords on top
and a simple melody
arrange it: intro, two verses, a break and an outro
what did we make? describe the whole song to me

name: re-everything-at-once
about: Regression re-run: One long compound request.

steps.say: make a beat at 120, add a bass in E minor on track 3, chords on track 7, a lead on track 5, arrange it in 4 scenes as intro verse chorus outro, add some swing, turn off the click, and tell me how to save it on my op-xy

name: re-relative-tweaks
about: Regression re-run: Relative sound changes over several turns, then half of one taken back.

steps.say: make a bassline on track 3
make it warmer
a bit more
too much, go halfway back

name: re-two-minute-song
about: Regression re-run: A song of a set length: the arithmetic of scenes and the song.

steps.say: make a song that lasts about 2 minutes at 120 bpm, with an intro, verse, chorus and outro

name: re-phrygian-double-time
about: Regression re-run: Many constraints in one message.

steps.say: make a song in 7/8 at 140 in D phrygian with a bass, a lead and chords, three parts, and the last part double time

name: teach-then-quiz
about: Teaching, then a quiz the user answers wrong.

steps.say: explain how the OP-XY sequencer works in a few sentences, then quiz me with one question
is it shift + record?

name: build-up-drop
about: A transition: a build-up with a riser into a drop.

steps.say: make an 8 bar build-up with a snare roll and a rising filter that drops into a big 4 bar drop, and play it
make a call and response between a lead on track 5 and the bass on track 3, 4 bars

name: chorus-louder
about: A mix change for one part of a song.

steps.say: make a song with a verse and a chorus, 4 bars each
make the chorus louder than the verse

name: mute-in-scene-2
about: A track muted in one scene only.

steps.say: make a two scene song with drums, bass and chords in both
mute the bass in the second scene only

name: two-envelopes
about: A concept shown on the replica.

steps.say: what's the difference between the filter envelope and the amp envelope? show me both on track 3

name: sharp-notes
about: Notes named with sharps in a flat key.

steps.say: write a bassline in F minor on track 3 using the notes F, G#, A#, C and D#

name: preset-maker-kit
about: The app's preset maker, asked about.

steps.say: I made a kit in the preset maker, how do I get it onto track 2 here and onto my op-xy?
